test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kalbelia is a famous folk dance of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalbelia is a folk dance mainly performed by the Kalbelia Community in Rajasthan.
 
• It is also known by other names like 'Sapera Dance' or 'Snake Charmer Dance'. 
 
• It was included in UNESCO's representative list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity from the year 2010. 
 
• In Kalbelia dance, males play generally various traditional instruments, and females of the Kalbelia Community perform the dance.
 
• Kalbelia dance is one of the most sensuous dances among all Rajasthani dances.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• National Park - Ranthambore National Park, Sariska Tiger Reserve, Mount Abu Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
 
 
• Maharashtra Dance forms are Lavani Dance, Dhangari Gaja, Folk Dances, Koli Dances, Tamasha etc.
 
• Kerala Dance forms are Kathakali, Mohiniyattam, Thirvathirakali, Chakyar Koothu etc.
 
• Gujarat Dance forms are Dandiya Raas, Garba, Tippani, Padhar etc.
